english.notes:
(i) Paragraph 22 of Schedule 4 to the Merchant Shipping (Safetyof Navigation) Regulations 2002 provides that it shall be a defence for aperson charged under these Regulations to show that he took all reasonablesteps to avoid the commission of the offence.
(ii)Paragraph 12 of Schedule 4 to the Merchant Shipping (Safetyof Navigation) Regulations 2002 provides that an offence under this regulationshall be an offence by the master of the ship.

other.penalty:
Summary: A fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
Indictment: Two years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
